Sponsors II may play one or more cards from hand or from the in-range display (pay the folder number for each); action strength plus 1 must cover their combined levels, and X-tokens can raise strength above 5. Resolve multiple cards one after another, finishing each card's immediate effects before the next, except after-finishing effects. Display replenishment waits until turn end. If using the break-money option on side II, take the money twice (twice the action strength), including when movement reaches the last space early.

grades.reason: Correct break order, hand limits, kiosk qualifiers including empty specials/excluding empty standards, appeal/kiosk/activated income and clockwise conflicting-card income order from the initiator/first affected player, refilling after each such player.
grades.answer_evidence: Break order: discard to hand limit (normally 3, or 5 with the particular university); clear Multiplier, Venom, and Constriction tokens from Action cards; return workers and replenish available partner zoos/universities; discard display folders 1 and 2, slide remaining cards down, and refill; take income; reset the Break token. Income includes appeal-track money, kiosk income, and break-income Sponsor/map bonuses. Each kiosk pays 1 money per adjacent unique building, special enclosure, occupied standard enclosure, and pavilion. Empty standard enclosures do not count, while empty special enclosures do. If multiple players take display cards during break income, resolve them clockwise from the break initiator (or first affected player clockwise from them) and refill the display after each such player's income, before the next affected player chooses.

grades.answer_evidence: At 2 conservation points, choose either an Action-card upgrade or activate an additional association worker. At 5 and 8, choose 5 money or the Bonus token by that space (if available). The first time anyone reaches 10, all players discard one Final Scoring card; if nobody reaches 10 before game end, all discard one before final scoring. The end is checked at the end of your own turn or during a break: it triggers when your Appeal and Conservation counters enter the same scoring area or pass one another. Appeal gained during another player's turn waits until the end of your own turn or a break to trigger, unless another player triggers the end first. If triggered at the end of a player's turn, that player finishes and every other player takes one more turn; if triggered during a break, all players take one more turn. Each Final Scoring card can grant at most 4 conservation points. Victory Points equal your Appeal value minus the lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive score wins; ties go to the player with the most supported conservation projects, then tied players share the victory.
